whatThisPluginAdds.text: Live Poll adds persisted polls, options, votes, public voting endpoints, and voter-retention cleanup to a Layout Builder widget. Result visibility and repeat-vote behavior are enforced by the poll domain Actions.

surfaceOutcome.text: Editors configure locale-specific polls in Layout Builder, and visitors can vote and see results only when the configured visibility policy permits it.

developers.text: Voting, publication sync, payload resolution, rate controls, and retention are separated into Actions and provider configuration with feature coverage.

teams.text: Teams can collect a bounded audience response on the page while controlling when aggregate results become public.

troubleshooting.cause: It has fewer than 2 or more than 10 options, or the question is over 500 characters
troubleshooting.check: Count the options and check the question length

troubleshooting.symptom: The poll will not accept its schedule
troubleshooting.cause: The closing time is not after the opening time, or the results setting is not always, after vote or after close
troubleshooting.check: Check the opens and closes times and the results visibility
troubleshooting.fix: Set the closing time after the opening time and pick a listed results setting
